sources: https://midnrreservations.com (location 'SFC Reedsburg Dam', resource and allowed-equipment API)

values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsn-z/reedsburgdam ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground'; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Reedsburg Dam State Forest Campground, Missaukee: rustic, open all year, North Higgins Lake SP 989-821-6125, 47 sites, $20, boat ramp R, reservable no), read 2026-10-25

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsn-z/reedsburgdam ('There are vault toilets.' 'Potable (drinking) water is available from a hand-pump well.'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: No advance reservations or payments: register on the day of arrival, no earlier than 8 a.m., online at MiDNRReservations.com (the DNR's same-day registration pilot) or by phone, once at the campground and ready to set up; then clip the hang tag to the site post.

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsn-z/reedsburgdam ('No reservations. Sites available on a first-come, first-served basis. All registrations now processed online or via phone.' 'You can register no earlier than 8 a.m. on the day of your arrival ... we do not accept advance payments or reservations.' 'Camping is limited to a 15-day maximum stay.') + https://midnrreservations.com (location 'SFC Reedsburg Dam', resource and allowed-equipment API) ('Some State Forest Campgrounds will pilot same day registrations in the reservation system ... You must be at the park and prepared to set up camp before registering') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table ('Reservable at MiDNRReservations.com' no), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 47 sites 'for tent and small trailer use' on the DNR page; the registration system's allowed equipment runs to 30 ft at most sites (24), 40 ft at nine (R1, R2, R5, R16, R17, R20, R23, R38, R43) and 50 ft at one (R3); 9 sites stop at 25 ft. No pull-throughs.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsn-z/reedsburgdam ('There are 47 sites for tent and small trailer use') + https://midnrreservations.com (location 'SFC Reedsburg Dam', resource and allowed-equipment API) (47 State Forest Campsites plus a host site: allowed 'Trailer or RV up to N'' max 20 ft x1, 25 x9, 30 x24, 35 x3, 40 x9, 50 x1; Pull Through 'No' at all 47) + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (47 campsites), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic state forest campground on the Muskegon River at the Reedsburg Dam impoundment, 5 mi NW of Houghton Lake via M-55 and County Road 300. Boat launch and carry-in access in the campground. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table + MiDNRReservations: $20, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 15-day max, 47 sites (confirmed, derived -> manual). Changed max_rig_ft 40 -> 50 (one site, R3; nine take 40 ft, most 30 ft) and added pull_through false from the registration system's site data. Added booking note: same-day registration online/by phone from 8 a.m. (no advance reservations). Season 'open all year' already manual, left. Type 'rustic', not equestrian; ORV 'no'. Phone 989-821-6125 matches. Note's '38 sites fit up to 40 ft, 15 waterfront' contradicted by the site data and dropped; field restatements trimmed.
